name: progress-pane
description: Mission control for long tasks, in a Notebook look: a validated worklog tool Claude updates at every step (done only after a green gate), facts the mod sees for itself (gate runs, commits, branch, agents, context and cost), drift hints where the two disagree, a band above the prompt, a /progress pane, and an Agents tab where every subagent has a pixel companion (the model picks the creature, the effort its accessory) with its own progress, figures and log.

pen.title: Pen glyph
pen.description: The glyph that marks the step in progress. Pick ● if your terminal font shows ✎ as a box.
